parameters.query:
insert into public.tc_audit_events
  (org_id, actor, entity_type, entity_id, action, before_state, after_state)
values
  ($1, $2, 'expense_record', $3, $4, $5::jsonb, $6::jsonb);

parameters.responseBody:
={
  "ok": true,
  "expense_record_id": "{{ $('Approval webhook').item.json.body.context.expense_record_id }}",
  "decision": "{{ $('Approval webhook').item.json.body.decision.action }}",
  "status": "{{ $('Update Expense Record status in tc_expense_records').item.json.status }}",
  "updated_at": "{{ $('Update Expense Record status in tc_expense_records').item.json.updated_at }}"
}

parameters.query:
select
  id,
  org_id,
  document_id,
  vendor_name,
  expense_date,
  total_amount,
  tax_amount,
  currency,
  confidence_score,
  needs_review,
  status,
  created_at,
  updated_at
from public.tc_expense_records
where org_id = $1
  and id = $2;

nodes.name: Select Current Expense Record from tc_expense_records

parameters.query:
update public.tc_expense_records
set
  status = $3,
  needs_review = case when $3 = 'APPROVED' then false else needs_review end,
  updated_at = now()
where org_id = $1
  and id = $2
returning
  id,
  org_id,
  status,
  needs_review,
  updated_at;
